sentences.en: She said, 'It's all about the journey,' and then she unquoted herself with a smile.
sentences.zh: 她说：‘重要的是过程。’然后微笑着结束了引用。

sentences.en: He started his speech by saying, 'As they say...' and then he unquoted them to continue his own thoughts.
sentences.zh: 他演讲时说道：‘正如他们所说……’然后结束引语，继续表达自己的想法。

sentences.en: The coach said, 'Never give up,' and I'll never forget when she unquoted that phrase.
sentences.zh: 教练说：‘永不放弃。’我永远不会忘记她说完这句话时的样子。
